'''Cassius Madine''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He fought against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]].

In [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|2}} As the events on Balmorra for all Republic classes, during which the player's encounters with Madine occur, take place during Act II, it can be assumed they take place in 3642 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]</ref> Madine was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] to aid the resistance against the Sith Empire. During that time, he became obsessed with the superweapon known as the [[Barrager]], believing it could help the Republic prevent another [[Sacking of Coruscant]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Madine's first name is revealed in a in-game mail message from [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Dannax]] concerning the commander's transfer request.<ref name="FW: Transfer Request Form 4187">{{TORcite|type=message|FW: Transfer Request Form 4187|Lieutenant Dannax}}</ref>
